title: Unit – 1 : Session – 10 : SLO – 2 | Database Processing
sections: 1) JDBC connection: Connection con = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/mydb", "user", "pass"); (after loading the MySQL driver).

2) INSERT: PreparedStatement ps = con.prepareStatement("INSERT INTO student(name, marks) VALUES (?, ?)"); ps.setString(1, "Sam"); ps.setInt(2, 90); ps.executeUpdate();  SELECT: ResultSet rs = con.createStatement().executeQuery("SELECT * FROM student"); while (rs.next()) System.out.println(rs.getString("name") + " " + rs.getInt("marks"));

3) Purpose of PreparedStatement: precompiled SQL → better performance for repeated execution; parameters via setXxx() prevent SQL injection by separating data from code; also improves readability and handles quoting/escaping automatically.
